# Mightora HAR Analyser
> Free open-source HTTP Archive (HAR) analysis that processes captures locally in a browser. Official site: https://har.mightora.io/

## Key resources
- [HAR analyser](https://har.mightora.io/): Inspect HTTP response errors, slow requests, wait times, size, and latency locally. No HAR upload endpoint.
- [How to open and analyse a HAR file](https://har.mightora.io/guides/how-to-analyse-har.html): Capture network traces in browser Developer Tools and troubleshoot them.
- [HAR timing fields explained](https://har.mightora.io/guides/har-performance-timings.html): DNS, connect, SSL/TLS, wait time, receive time, and P95.
- [Run the analyser offline](https://har.mightora.io/guides/offline-har-analysis.html): Use a downloadable self-contained HTML file with no runtime internet requirements.
- [HAR security and safe sharing](https://har.mightora.io/guides/har-security-privacy.html): HAR files may contain bearer tokens, cookies, PII and request/response contents.
- [Download offline ZIP](https://har.mightora.io/downloads/mightora-har-offline.zip): Includes har-analyser.html, README.txt and LICENSE.txt.
- [Source code](https://github.com/mightora/har): MIT-licensed public GitHub repository.

## Important details
- Processing is local. The web edition uses a browser Web Worker and external Mightora UI resources; the offline HTML embeds all dependencies and uses restrictive content security policy.
- Original HAR captures can contain secrets. Do not share raw HARs before reviewing and redacting them.
- Sanitised JSON exports do not contain raw headers, cookies or response bodies, but may retain hostnames and identifying URL paths.
- Host aggregate durations are cumulative request durations, not page load time.
- P95 is calculated from durations in the loaded HAR sample, not across production traffic.

## About
Maintained under the Mightora brand. Created by TechTweedie. UK English editorial content.
